# Large Document (Performance Test)

This generated file (by `tools/gen_large.py`, deterministic seed) is about 2.5 MB of realistic mixed Markdown: 60 chapters of headings at all levels, long paragraphs with inline formatting, links, emoji and footnotes, lists and task lists, tables, fenced code in many languages, block quotes, alerts, images and `<details>` blocks. Use it to measure load time, time to first paint, scrolling smoothness (drag the thumb and use Page Down), memory usage, search, and select-all/copy on a large document. The content is meaningless on purpose.
